name: Renu
notes: Tense respect. Renu studies meaning; Kaladatta studies form. Rarely agree, but neither dismisses the other.

name: Balamitra
notes: Professional relationship. Balamitra relies on Kaladatta to keep critical structures stable.

name: Vasu
notes: Occasional cooperation on structural preservation of the shrine and temple systems.

name: Senaka
notes: Finds her interpretations interesting but ungrounded.

name: Chapala
notes: Skeptical of him, but acknowledges his attention to detail.

name: Bhumaka
notes: Respects his understanding of physical pressure on terrain.
